scoring.note: NEVER equal thirds. Material Safety reported separately — not in overall.
scoring.non_disclosure_policy: Products NEVER penalized for not disclosing specs. Unknown components get class-conditional prior scores (Bayesian imputation). CERTIFICATION_FLOOR used when product has certification but no specific number published. Class-conditional performance floors enforce minimum scores by material class (fiberglass/wood-clad=6.0, composite=5.5, vinyl=5.0) so non-disclosure never drags a score below what the class would reasonably achieve.
scoring.evidence_pin_policy: Evidence files only pin performance subscores when evidence_level is PUBLISHED or BOUNDED. CERTIFICATION_FLOOR and lower let Bot 2's scores pass through.

class_perf_floors.note: Applied in orchestrator after Bot 2 scoring. Only triggers when evidence_level is NOT PUBLISHED or BOUNDED.
